# NeoFamily

> > NeoFamily is a comprehensive online school specializing in EGE (Russian state exam) preparation across all subjects, targeting scores of 80+ with expert instructors and structured courses.

NeoFamily offers flexible exam preparation options including express courses, half-year programs, and full-year comprehensive courses for EGE-2026 across multiple subjects. The platform combines video lessons, task banks, tutoring support, and proven student results led by experienced educators.

## Key Topics

- EGE (ЕГЭ)
- EGE-2026
- Online exam preparation
- High-score preparation (80+)
- Express courses
- Half-year courses
- Full-year courses
- Russian Language
- Biology
- Chemistry
- Profile Mathematics
- Student testimonials
- Student results
- Online learning
- FIPИ (Russian exam authority)
